source.plan: G6 - Bramblewood_2.xlsx, sheet Skills, column II (owner 11-16 20:43; 20:48 "stick to 50+")
source.lists: canonical/map-pools.json (main maps 0-20, first list holding the card)

basics.name: Evasive
basics.tip: Dodges half of all single-target attacks and skills.

basics.name: Flying
basics.tip: Dodges half of all attacks from units without Flying.

basics.name: Nursing
basics.k: 1 (I think we'll use this instead of "Heal". And the action of Heal will be called "Nurse".)
basics.tip: Heal your weakest wounded unit for 2 every upkeep.

basics.name: Swarm
basics.tip: +1 Attack for every ally that shares a type with it.

basics.name: Arrow
basics.tip: While Ready, shoot the enemy facing it (or the nearest) for N damage every upkeep.

basics.name: Diurnal
basics.tip: By day: +0/+0.

basics.name: Foraging
basics.tip: +1 Berry each turn. 3 Berries heal your most hurt other ally 3.

basics.name: Guardian
basics.tip: Takes the plain attacks aimed at its adjacent allies (not the bramble).

basics.name: Inspiring
basics.tip: Attacking gives adjacent allies N Inspiration: +1 Attack each, spent on their next hit.

basics.name: Nocturnal
basics.tip: At night: +0/+0.

basics.name: Thorns
basics.tip: Melee attackers take N damage.

basics.name: Armor
basics.tip: Takes N less damage from every swing, arrow and spit but magic (never below 0). Magic goes past it.

basics.name: Pierce
basics.tip: Its melee hits ignore N Armor.

basics.name: Poison Barbs
basics.tip: Each unit that swings at it gets 1 Venom. Like Thorns, it can't be redirected.

basics.name: Tide
basics.tip: Flood: +1 Attack. Ebb: +1 Armor.

basics.name: Cleave
basics.tip: Also deals 1 damage to the units beside its target.

basics.name: Pounce
basics.tip: When played: 1 damage to the foe facing it, else one beside it, else the bramble.

basics.name: Swift
basics.tip: Always attacks first, and dodges half the attacks from units without Swift.

basics.name: Bloom
basics.tip: Each Ready round its conditions hold: a copy with +1/+1 grows in an adjacent slot.

basics.name: Meiosis
basics.tip: When it dies, it splits into 2 halves: half the stats and skill numbers, no Meiosis.

basics.name: Rebuild
basics.tip: While Ready, restore 2 Health to your bramble every upkeep.

basics.name: Shield
basics.tip: Arrives with 1 Shield: temporary Health that soaks damage first.

basics.name: Bleed
basics.tip: Every melee hit it lands adds N Bleed.

basics.name: Constrict
basics.tip: Its hits Bind the target for a round and squeeze it for 2.

basics.name: Cure
basics.tip: Every upkeep, cure up to 2 Venom from your most envenomed unit. Venom only.

basics.name: Regeneration
basics.tip: Heals N every upkeep.

basics.name: Twin Strike
basics.tip: Attacks twice.

basics.name: Ambush
basics.tip: When an enemy unit enters the slot facing it (played, spawned or moved in), deal 3 damage to it.

basics.name: Leech
basics.tip: Heals for the damage its hits deal.

basics.name: Parasite
basics.tip: Can be played onto an enemy unit in reach. It feeds on it each round: its Attack in damage.

basics.name: Carrion
basics.tip: Whenever another unit dies, heal 2.

basics.name: Corrode
basics.tip: Its hits add N Corrode.

basics.name: Illuminate
basics.k: 1 (We need to find an alternate use. Don't give diurnal units anything. it isn't the sun!)
basics.why: dark Map 8 (7 of 8 fights dark, 1 pitch black): lights the dark for the whole side, not one unit (Darksight); your note "find another use"
basics.tip: Lights up the dark: your units don't miss in darkness, and nor does the enemy unit facing it.

basics.name: Darksight
basics.tip: It can see in darkness.

basics.name: Web
basics.tip: Its hits Web the target for 1 round.

basics.name: Trident
basics.tip: One three-pronged swing straight ahead: full Attack in front, half to the units on its left and right.

basics.name: Electricity
basics.k: 1 (To me, Electricity and Electric type attacks count as 1 skill. Same as Venom type and Venomous.)
basics.why: Maps 9-10 eels (Voltaic Eel, Coral Current Eel); your note: Electricity + electric attack = one skill
basics.tip: Its hits arc to a unit adjacent to the target for 1 lightning damage.

basics.name: Weaken
basics.tip: Its hits take 1 Attack from the target for good.

basics.name: Natural Leader
basics.tip: Can be your Leader.

basics.name: Twin Shot
basics.tip: While Ready, shoot two random enemy units for 2 damage each every upkeep.

basics.name: Siege
basics.tip: Deals 2 more damage to Structures and to the enemy bramble.

basics.name: Keen Sense
basics.why: real gap: Blind (18-4 blinding sandstorm, Smoke Bomb on Map 19, Blind cards on 18); no II 1 skill resists Blind (Darksight is the dark only)
basics.tip: Darkness and Blind don't make it miss grounded units; it can't be Blinded.

basics.name: Stealth
basics.why: stoats and foxes (Maps 12-14); Tall Grass (Map 15) makes Stealth units strike first
basics.tip: Always attacks the enemy bramble.

basics.name: Harbinger
basics.tip: Whenever another unit dies, on either side, it gains +1/+1 (up to 3 a round).

basics.name: Mighty
basics.tip: Deals double damage.

basics.name: Pack
basics.tip: Pack units of its type side by side each get +1/+1 per Pack point in the chain.

basics.name: Stampede
basics.why: herd animals of Maps 15 and 20 (Warhorse, Gilded Roadwarden, Ur-Elk): bramble damage through the line
basics.tip: Damage left over from a kill carries on into the enemy bramble.

basics.name: Sturdy
basics.tip: Takes half damage.

basics.name: Momentum
basics.why: Map 17 had no new skill; wolves and ermine that grow with each kill (your Map-12 sheet: Map 17 Momentum)
basics.tip: +N Attack every time it kills a unit.

basics.name: Trap
basics.tip: When played, trap the empty enemy slot facing it: the next card played there takes 5 damage.

basics.name: Recoil
basics.tip: Each attack also deals N damage to itself.

singles.name: Feeble
singles.why: a cub hits for half; the drawback buys it Health (was vanilla)
singles.tip: Deals half damage.

singles.name: Fletcher
singles.why: already on this owner card (quartermaster of arrows)
singles.tip: Your units' ranged shots deal 1 more damage.

singles.name: Helmet
singles.why: no armoured-head animal left without two skills (Gilded Roadwarden holds Pounce + Stampede)
singles.tip: Half the shots aimed at it glance off, once; then the helmet is gone.

singles.name: Herald
singles.why: the name: a herald for your Leader
singles.tip: Your Leader has {+N/+N} while it lives.

singles.name: Pitchfork
singles.why: a village miller with a pitchfork (was vanilla)
singles.tip: One four-pronged swing, aimed left or right at random: half Attack on each of 4 neighbouring columns.

singles.name: Repair
singles.k: (Same as Rebuild but for structures. Not sure about this one)
singles.why: already on this owner card (roots mend the bramble)
singles.tip: Each turn, repairs the most damaged nearby structure for 2; with none, your bramble for 1.

singles.name: Scare
singles.why: already on it (the cicada's din)
singles.tip: Attacks against it deal N less damage.

singles.name: Wave
singles.why: a riptide pushes (your Map-12 sheet: Map 10 Wave)
singles.tip: Hits push the target 1 column either way; crashing into a unit deals 1 to both.

singles.name: Acid
singles.why: the name (caustic); your Map-12 sheet: Map 18 Acid
singles.tip: While Ready, every upkeep: 2 acid damage and 1 Corrode to the foe facing it (or nearest).

singles.name: Bola
singles.why: no thrower among the Maps 0-20 animals
singles.tip: Each Ready round: a 1-damage bola; the unit hit is Pinned next turn (no swing, move or dodge).

singles.name: Boomerang
singles.why: no thrower among the Maps 0-20 animals
singles.tip: Its throw comes back next round and hits the same target again. Catch it!

singles.name: Crab Claws
singles.why: already on this owner card
singles.tip: Pinches a random enemy to its left or right, never the one in front; with none, the bramble.

singles.name: Dynamite
singles.k: 1A (Same as 1, but mainly to represent the 'civilised society' animals)
singles.why: a sapper, a "civilised" animal (your K note 1A)
singles.tip: A 3-upkeep fuse; at 0 it blows: 5 fire damage to every surrounding unit.

singles.name: Exploit
singles.why: no clean fit; Pierce and Corrode already answer tough targets
singles.tip: Its hits put 2 Exploit tokens on the target: each later hit on it deals 1 more.

singles.name: Fork
singles.why: no forked striker; Cleave and Trident cover side hits
singles.tip: Strikes up to 2 adjacent enemies in front of this unit

singles.name: Loyal
singles.why: already on it (sworn to the leader)
singles.tip: While an ally leader is on the field: +0/+0.

singles.name: Pickpocket
singles.iiNote: I think this steals items only
singles.why: a thieving rat (owner card: its Devour had to go)
singles.tip: Its hits steal 1 of the target's tokens; on the bramble, 1 of its lowest-ranked resource.

singles.name: Pillage
singles.why: new: not in the engine yet (see Gaps); proposed home Gull Thief once built
singles.tip: Steals one (1) random resource.

singles.name: Rainrunner
singles.why: already on this owner card; no main map of 0-20 has rain (see Gaps)
singles.tip: In rain: +N/+N, and it can't be blocked.

singles.name: Reach
singles.why: already on it (a diving bird that reaches fliers)
singles.tip: Flying can't dodge its attacks.

singles.name: Smoke Bomb
singles.why: already on it (the name)
singles.tip: Each round, 1 in 2: smoke-bombs a random unit. Allies hide in Smoke; enemies are Blinded.

singles.name: Snipe
singles.why: no marksman left without two skills (Map 14 has none)
singles.tip: While Ready, if nothing faces it, shoot a random enemy unit for 1 every upkeep.

singles.name: Broodkeeper
singles.iiNote: I don't really like the name
singles.why: a mother carrying her young; Map 7 makes units (Bloom, Meiosis, the Carcass maggots)
singles.tip: Your units made by abilities arrive with +1/+1.

singles.name: Esprit
singles.why: Kin cards (factions) are not on these lists
singles.tip: +0/+0 whenever another of your Kin enters play.

singles.name: Expose
singles.why: a diving tern spots what hides; answers Invisible (Maps 6, 17)
singles.tip: Its hits strip the target's hiding for 2 rounds: Invisible, Evasive, Smoke and Shadow stop working.

singles.name: Fencing
singles.why: already on it (a duelist)
singles.tip: Its attacks can't be dodged by Evasive or Swift units.

singles.name: Herbalist
singles.why: already on it, now beside Nursing
singles.tip: Every heal on your units heals 1 more.

singles.name: Last Stand
singles.why: a honey badger never quits
singles.tip: While your bramble is at a third of its Health or less: +1/+1.

singles.name: Lone Wolf
singles.why: a solitary hunter
singles.tip: +0/+0 for each empty slot within 2 of it, and +0/+0 more when all 4 are empty.

singles.name: Molting
singles.why: a snake sheds its skin
singles.tip: Every 2 rounds: +1/+1 for good, but +1 Wait.

singles.name: Delivery
singles.why: already on this owner card
singles.tip: Resource

singles.name: Octolash
singles.why: no octopus on Maps 0-20
singles.tip: Hits the 8 nearest enemy units with full Attack.

singles.name: Pearl
singles.why: already on it as Delivery {Pearl}
singles.tip: When it becomes Ready, you gain 1 Pearl. A Pearl pays for 1 Lumber or 1 Stone.

singles.name: Smelter
singles.why: no Metal on Maps 0-20
singles.tip: Each turn while Ready, turns 2 Lumber and 2 Stone into 1 Metal, if you have them.

singles.name: Spawner
singles.k: 7 (Maybe better to use this instead of Every turn -> {Spawn} trigger-action pairs)
singles.why: no spawner card on Maps 0-20 lists
singles.tip: While Ready, it spawns N into the free slot nearest it every turn.

singles.name: Stonecutter
singles.k: 7 (But maybe instead it's every turn, turn 2 lumber into 1 stone)
singles.why: a quarry digger; the first Stone maker of the road (see Gaps: Phoenix Mushrooms)
singles.tip: Every second turn while Ready, you gain 1 Stone.

singles.name: Daunt
singles.why: already on it (your Map-12 sheet: Map 11 Daunt)
singles.tip: On every melee hit it lands, the target loses N Attack until the end of next round. Stacks.

singles.name: Fragile
singles.k: (like Brittle, however this is more 'generic' in flavour - better)
singles.why: no fitting card; the Glass Dunes animals are tough
singles.tip: Takes double damage.

singles.name: Offspring
singles.why: no card; costs Lumber the early maps lack
singles.tip: When it arrives, 1 copies hatch beside it: half its Attack and Health (rounded down), Wait 1, no Offspring.

singles.name: Taunt
singles.why: already on it (the big-nosed male)
singles.tip: Enemies facing it or beside that column must attack it.

singles.name: Bludgeon
singles.why: already on it (one huge claw)
singles.tip: Its hits take 1 Attack and knock out one of the target's skills.

singles.name: Perforate
singles.why: Pierce + Bleed + Puncture cover it
singles.tip: Its melee hits ignore and strip N Armor, add N Bleed and deal N damage to the enemy bramble.

singles.name: Pulverise
singles.why: an icebreaker breaks armour
singles.tip: Ignores Armor, double damage to Structures. A landed swing breaks the target's Armor, Magic Armor and equipment.

singles.name: Puncture
singles.why: already on this owner card (Reload had to go)
singles.tip: Each melee hit also deals N damage to the enemy bramble.

notes.Pillage: New. No key in the engine, the prices or the texts (`pillage` appears nowhere). Build it from Pickpocket's resource half: the engine already takes resources off the opposing bramble (`sk2TakeRes`, used by Pickpocket and Sabotage). A small engine package: key, price, text, 12 language packs. Proposed home: Gull Thief (owner card) in place of its "On Hit: Deliver 1 Lumber", once built.
notes.Rainrunner: Exists (key `rainrunner`, bramblewood-engine.js: +N/+N and unblockable in a rain field). On Puddle Skimmer (owner card). No main map of 0-20 has rain, so on the road it never fires.
notes.Pickpocket: Exists (key `pickpocket`, ENG28). Today a landed hit takes N of the unit's tokens (Berries, prayer tokens, Scavenge / Salvage points, Creativity) and, where the tokens fall short or it hits the bramble, the opponent's resources. Your note "steals items only": proposed Pickpocket keeps the token theft only and the resource part becomes Pillage. Open: do "items" include equipment? (question 3)
notes.Broodkeeper: Exists (key `broodkeeper`; on no card). Name candidates: **Nurture**, **Hatchery**, **Rearing** (question 4). Proposed home: Wolf Spider Mother (Map 7, where Bloom, Meiosis and the Carcass maggots make units).

questions: **Venomous has no II rank**, so this plan moves it off its 13 Maps 0-20 cards (Bee Sentry, Water Shrew, Platypus, Fire Ant Raft, Adder Ambusher, Puffball, Gallery Orb-Weaver, Banded Sea Krait, Crown-of-thorns Star, Monarch Wingblade, Caustic Scorpion, Sand Widow, Obsidian Scorpion). Cure (II 1) is then left with Poison Barbs and Swamp Fever as the venom on the road. Rank Venomous II 1 (they keep it), or keep it off?
**Stone on Map 7:** Phoenix Mushrooms costs 1 Stone, and the first Stone maker is Quarry Mole (Stonecutter, Map 8). Accept one map late, or switch its Stone cost to Lumber?
**Pickpocket, "items only":** items = the tokens a unit carries (Berries, prayer tokens), or equipment as well? Its resource theft becomes Pillage (to build).
**Rainrunner** never fires on Maps 0-20 (no rain there). Give a main map a rain field (Thistlewood or Sunken Hollow), or take it off Puddle Skimmer (Evasive, as REDESIGN1)?

**Map 1 is busy:** Guardian, Foraging, Inspiring and Thorns are new there, and Chipmunk Skirmisher (owner card) also brings Arrow, so 5 new skills (plus light Diurnal and Nocturnal). Keep Arrow on it, or hold Arrow to Map 3?
**Thin basics:** Constrict (Constrictor Coil) and Cure (Marsh-mallow Hare) have one carrier each on these lists. Add a second from a side map, or accept one?

**20 owner cards sit outside the band** with their skills unchanged (Bee Warden 36.8%, Earthworm 48.6%, Duckling 56.7%, Pincushion Urchin 58%, Worker Ant 123.7%, Alley Cat 123.2% ...): left as they are.
